title: French Briny Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with French sausages and a briny, savory sauce.
instructions: Slice the sausages into 1-inch pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and potato to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
